case.title: The Safe House Mystery
case.introduction: Tonight at The Ashgrove Safe House, the loss of a secret new machine has turned the evening upside down. No one is allowed to leave. 5 guests are still here, and each one is hiding something. One of them is not who they say they are. Find that person.
case.crime: The loss of a secret new machine
case.target_fake_identity: Sofia Sinclair, a wine taster people trust
case.escape_plan: Sofia Sinclair plans to sneak out while everyone is confused, and be gone before the police arrive.

rooms.name: The Grand Lobby
rooms.description: A huge hall with stone floors and a wide staircase.

rooms.name: The Lounge
rooms.description: Soft yellow light, leather chairs, and slow music playing.

rooms.name: The Dining Room
rooms.description: A long table, still set for dinner.

rooms.name: The Private Study
rooms.description: Book shelves, a heavy desk, and one locked drawer.

rooms.name: The Terrace Garden
rooms.description: Cool night air, tall bushes, and a view of the water.

rooms.name: The Guest Rooms
rooms.description: A hallway of numbered doors. Most are half open.

characters.name: Sofia Sinclair
characters.background: A wine taster with a messy past.
characters.secret: Sofia is covering for a family member.
characters.goal: Sofia wants to leave before anyone finds out the truth.
characters.alibi: Says they were in The Grand Lobby when it happened.

relationships.kind: brother or sister who no longer speaks to them

knowledge: Knows exactly how the crime was done.
lies: Says they never went into the room where the main clue was found.
Says all their papers are real.

timeline.description: The crime happens: the loss of a secret new machine.
The alarm goes off. No one may leave.
Sofia Sinclair is seen moving toward a side door.

evidence.name: a wine glass
evidence.description: A half-full glass. The drink smells bitter.

evidence.name: muddy shoes
evidence.description: Costly shoes covered in garden mud, but it has not rained inside.

evidence.name: a hidden key
evidence.description: A small brass key taped under a drawer.

evidence.name: a fake passport
evidence.description: It looks real, but the year of birth is a little bit wrong.

evidence.name: a cheap phone
evidence.description: A cheap phone with only one number called.

evidence.name: a photo
evidence.description: A photo of two guests who say they have never met.

evidence.name: a cloth with blood on it
evidence.description: A fine cloth with two letters sewn on it and a dark stain.

hidden_clues: Sofia Sinclair's story about where they were does not match the a wine glass.
Two guests say they have never met, but a photo shows they have.

solution.target_true_identity: A wanted criminal pretending to be a wine taster
solution.reasoning: Sofia Sinclair is the hidden person. The main clues (a wine glass, muddy shoes) put them at the scene and show their story is not true. Their papers are fake too.

state.current_objective: One of the 5 guests at The Ashgrove Safe House is using a fake name. Search the rooms, talk to everyone, and find the person behind the loss of a secret new machine. Some guests lie. Check their stories carefully.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Tonight at The Ashgrove Safe House, the loss of a secret new machine has turned the evening upside down. No one is allowed to leave. 5 guests are still here, and each one is hiding something. One of them is not who they say they are. Find that person.

transcript.speaker: Verdict
transcript.text: The mask comes off. The clues box them in and they lose their calm. The fake name, the story that never matched — all of it is now in the open. You were right. Case closed, detective.
